Selected work

Real fixes, documented

Actual before-and-after results from live stores I've managed — red products cleared to approved, indexing, on-store Liquid work, and the day-to-day catalog and listing work behind them.

01 Google Merchant Center

Cleared a "Misrepresentation" account issue

An account was flagged for misrepresentation — a serious status that blocks free listings and Shopping ads entirely. I audited the store's policies, contact info and product claims, corrected the flagged issues and submitted the account for review. Google confirmed the issue no longer appears.

Before · Issue flagged After · Review passed
02 Google Compliance

Cleared red products back to approved

Products were sitting as red Not approved items in Merchant Center — invisible to shoppers and earning nothing. I investigated each one (attributes, images, GTIN and policy flags), fixed the root cause in Shopify, and re-submitted. They moved to Approved and started showing on Google Shopping and free listings.

Showing on Google · Free + Ads
03 Search Console

Requested indexing → live on Google

To support Merchant Center review and organic discovery, I used Google Search Console's URL Inspection to request indexing on key store URLs, then verified the outcome. Pages moved from a pending request to a confirmed URL is on Google state.

Indexing requested URL is on Google
04 Performance & Reporting

Compliant store, traction tracked daily

With products approved and compliant, the store's presence on Google grew — clicks climbing week over week. I track this in daily reports, flagging high-traffic products that aren't converting so they can be optimized or repriced against COGS.

Clicks trending up Tracked in daily reports
05 Liquid / Theme

Custom size charts built in Liquid

Fashion needs sizing shoppers can trust. I built size-guide tables directly into the theme with Liquid so they render on every product page — no third-party app, fully styled to match the store, and easy to update per collection.

{% comment %} size-chart.liquid {% endcomment %}
{% for row in section.settings.sizes %}
  <tr><td>{{ row.label }}</td>
    <td>{{ row.chest }}</td></tr>
{% endfor %}
06 Catalog & Listings

Full catalog build & rich product copy

Product listing at scale — organized collections, structured variants, and detailed, non-generic descriptions written in-market. Every product set up cleanly in Shopify admin and cross-checked against the feed.

Collections Variants SEO copy Feed-ready
How I work

How I run a store

A repeatable weekly loop — keep the store live and compliant, priced for profit, and improving off real numbers.

01

Audit

Store-readiness review — content, links, policies, product data and Merchant Center status.

02

List & optimize

List products (with the team), sharpen titles & descriptions, and rescue high-traffic items with no sales.

03

Price for profit

Set prices from COGS, build the profit sheet, and protect margins across the catalog.

04

Keep compliant

05

Report & improve

A daily report on what's working and what to fix next — so every week moves the store forward.

About

A store manager, not just a VA

I run Shopify stores end-to-end and keep them compliant on Google. Day-to-day that means listings, catalog, pricing and customer service — while making sure every product stays approved and live in Merchant Center, with red products cleared fast.

I work from the numbers: COGS-based pricing, profit sheets and daily performance reports that flag exactly what to fix next — like high-traffic products that aren't converting. And I lead product-listing teams, setting the standard and keeping output consistent at scale.
